96 bool ToolsInterfaceCore::rebootHardware(bool torque_on)
97 {
98  bool res = true;
99  if (_toolState && _toolState->isValid())
100  {
101  // reboot
102  bool res = _ttl_interface->rebootHardware(_toolState);
103 
104  // re init
105  if (res)
106  initHardware(torque_on, _temperature_limit, _shutdown_configuration,
107  _available_tools_map.at(_toolState->getId()));
108  }
109  // else no tool, return ok
110 
111  return res;
112 }

117 int ToolsInterfaceCore::initHardware(bool torque_on, uint8_t temperature_limit, uint8_t shutdown_configuration,
118  const ToolConfig &config)
119 {
120  uint8_t motor_id;
121  if (_toolState)
122  {
123  motor_id = _toolState->getId();
124  if (EHardwareType::XL330 == _toolState->getHardwareType())
125  {
126  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_TORQUE, motor_id,
127  std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ false }));
128 
129  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(
130  EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_TEMPERATURE_LIMIT, motor_id, std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ temperature_limit }));
131  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(
132  EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_SHUTDOWN, motor_id, std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ shutdown_configuration }));
133 
134  uint8_t control_mode = 5; // torque + position
135  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(
136  EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_CONTROL_MODE, motor_id, std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ control_mode }));
137 
138  _toolState->setPositionPGain(static_cast<uint32_t>(config.params.pid.at("p")));
139  _toolState->setPositionIGain(static_cast<uint32_t>(config.params.pid.at("i")));
140  _toolState->setPositionDGain(static_cast<uint32_t>(config.params.pid.at("d")));
141  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(
142  EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_PID, motor_id,
143  std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ _toolState->getPositionPGain(), _toolState->getPositionIGain(),
144  _toolState->getPositionDGain(), _toolState->getVelocityPGain(),
145  _toolState->getVelocityIGain(), _toolState->getFF1Gain(),
146  _toolState->getFF2Gain() }));
147 
148  _toolState->setVelProfile(config.params.velocity_profile);
149  _toolState->setAccProfile(config.params.acceleration_profile);
150  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(
151  EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_PROFILE, motor_id,
152  std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ _toolState->getVelProfile(), _toolState->getAccProfile() }));
153  }
154  // TORQUE cmd on if ned2, off otherwise
155  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(
156  EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_TORQUE, motor_id, std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ torque_on }));
157  }
158  return niryo_robot_msgs::CommandStatus::SUCCESS;
159 }

165 void ToolsInterfaceCore::initParameters(ros::NodeHandle &nh)
166 {
167  double tool_connection_frequency{ 1.0 };
168  nh.getParam("check_tool_connection_frequency", tool_connection_frequency);
169  nh.getParam("vacuum_pump_timeout", _vacuum_pump_timeout);
170  nh.getParam("gripper_timeout", _gripper_timeout);
171 
172  ROS_DEBUG("ToolsInterfaceCore::initParameters - check tool connection frequency : %f", tool_connection_frequency);
173 
174  assert(tool_connection_frequency);
175  _tool_connection_publisher_duration = ros::Duration(1.0 / tool_connection_frequency);
176 
177  std::vector<int> idList;
178  std::vector<string> typeList;
179  std::vector<string> nameList;
180  std::vector<ToolParams> tool_params;
181  XmlRpc::XmlRpcValue params_list;
182 
183  _available_tools_map.clear();
184  nh.getParam("tools_params/id_list", idList);
185  nh.getParam("tools_params/type_list", typeList);
186  nh.getParam("tools_params/name_list", nameList);
187  nh.getParam("tools_params/temperature_limit", _temperature_limit);
188  nh.getParam("tools_params/shutdown_configuration", _shutdown_configuration);
189  nh.getParam("simulation_mode", _simulation_mode);
190  nh.getParam("simu_gripper", _use_simu_gripper);
191  if (nh.getParam("tools_params/params_list", params_list))
192  {
193  for (int i = 0; i < params_list.size(); ++i)
194  {
195  ToolParams params;
196  params.velocity_profile = static_cast<int>(params_list[i]["velocity_profile"]);
197  params.acceleration_profile = static_cast<int>(params_list[i]["acceleration_profile"]);
198  params.pid["p"] = static_cast<int>(params_list[i]["pid"]["p"]);
199  params.pid["i"] = static_cast<int>(params_list[i]["pid"]["i"]);
200  params.pid["d"] = static_cast<int>(params_list[i]["pid"]["d"]);
201  tool_params.push_back(params);
202  }
203  }
204 
205  // check that the three lists have the same size
206  if (idList.size() == typeList.size() && idList.size() == nameList.size())
207  {
208  // put everything in maps
209  for (size_t i = 0; i < idList.size(); ++i)
210  {
211  auto id = static_cast<uint8_t>(idList.at(i));
212  EHardwareType type = HardwareTypeEnum(typeList.at(i).c_str());
213  std::string name = nameList.at(i);
214  int velocity_profile = tool_params.at(i).velocity_profile;
215  int acceleration_profile = tool_params.at(i).acceleration_profile;
216  std::map<std::string, uint32_t> pid = tool_params.at(i).pid;
217 
218  if (!_available_tools_map.count(id))
219  {
220  if (EHardwareType::UNKNOWN != type)
221  {
222  auto tool_config = ToolConfig{ name, type, ToolParams{ velocity_profile, acceleration_profile, pid } };
223 
224  _available_tools_map.insert(std::make_pair(id, tool_config));
225  }
226  else
227  ROS_ERROR(
228  "ToolsInterfaceCore::initParameters - unknown type %s. "
229  "Please check your configuration file (tools_interface/config/default.yaml)",
230  typeList.at(id).c_str());
231  }
232  else
233  ROS_ERROR(
234  "ToolsInterfaceCore::initParameters - duplicate id %d. "
235  "Please check your configuration file (tools_interface/config/default.yaml)",
236  id);
237  }
238  }
239  else
240  {
241  ROS_ERROR(
242  "ToolsInterfaceCore::initParameters - wrong dynamixel configuration. "
243  "Please check your configuration file (tools_interface/config/default.yaml)");
244  }
245 
246  for (auto const &tool : _available_tools_map)
247  {
248  ROS_DEBUG("ToolsInterfaceCore::initParameters - Available tools map: %d => %s (%s)", static_cast<int>(tool.first),
249  tool.second.name.c_str(), HardwareTypeEnum(tool.second.type).toString().c_str());
250  }
251 }

322  niryo_robot_msgs::SetInt::Response &res)

325  _ttl_interface->changeTool(req.value, res.message, res.status);

339 bool ToolsInterfaceCore::_callbackPingAndSetTool(tools_interface::PingDxlTool::Request & /*req*/,
340  tools_interface::PingDxlTool::Response &res)
341 {
342  res.tool.id = -1;
343  res.tool.motor_type = Tool::NO_MOTOR;
344 
345  res.tool.position = 0;
346  res.tool.state = ToolState::TOOL_STATE_PING_ERROR;
347 
348  res.state = res.tool.state;
349 
350  std::lock_guard<mutex> lck(_tool_mutex);
351  // Unequip tool
352  if (_toolState && _toolState->isValid())
353  {
354  // unmanage tool
355  _ttl_interface->unsetTool(_toolState->getId());
356 
357  // reset tool state as default = no tool
358  _toolState->reset();
359  }
360 
361  // Search new tool
362  std::vector<uint8_t> motor_list = _ttl_interface->scanTools();
363  for (auto const &m_id : motor_list)
364  {
365  if (_available_tools_map.count(m_id))
366  {
367  // reset tool state
368  _toolState =
369  std::make_shared<ToolState>(_available_tools_map.at(m_id).name, _available_tools_map.at(m_id).type, m_id);
370  break;
371  }
372  }
373 
374  // if new tool has been found
375  if (_toolState)
376  {
377  if (_toolState->isValid())
378  {
379  // Try 3 times
380  for (int tries = 0; tries < 3; tries++)
381  {
382  int result = _ttl_interface->setTool(_toolState);
383 
384  // on success, tool is set, we initialize it and go out of loop
385  if (niryo_robot_msgs::CommandStatus::SUCCESS == result &&
386  niryo_robot_msgs::CommandStatus::SUCCESS == initHardware(true, _temperature_limit, _shutdown_configuration,
387  _available_tools_map.at(_toolState->getId())))
388  {
389  _toolState->setState(ToolState::TOOL_STATE_PING_OK);
390 
391  ros::Duration(0.05).sleep();
392  ROS_INFO("ToolsInterfaceCore::_callbackPingAndSetDxlTool - Set tool success !");
393 
394  break;
395  }
396 
397  ROS_WARN(
398  "ToolsInterfaceCore::_callbackPingAndSetDxlTool - "
399  "Set tool failure, return : %d. Retrying (%d)...",
400  result, tries);
401  }
402 
403  // on failure after three tries
404  if (ToolState::TOOL_STATE_PING_OK != _toolState->getState())
405  {
406  ROS_ERROR("ToolsInterfaceCore::_callbackPingAndSetDxlTool - Fail to set tool, return : %d",
407  _toolState->getState());
408 
409  // reset toolstate to indicate that it is not usable
410  _toolState->reset();
411 
412  ros::Duration(0.05).sleep();
413  }
414  }
415  else // no tool found, no tool set (it is not an error, the tool does not exists)
416  {
417  _toolState->setState(ToolState::TOOL_STATE_PING_OK);
418 
419  ros::Duration(0.05).sleep();
420  }
421 
422  res.state = _toolState->getState();
423  }
424 
425  return true;
426 }
427

447  res.message = "No Tool";
448  }
449 
450  return true;

459 bool ToolsInterfaceCore::_callbackControlGripper(tools_interface::ToolCommand::Request &req,
460  tools_interface::ToolCommand::Response &res)
461 {
462  lock_guard<mutex> lck(_tool_mutex);
463  res.state = ToolState::TOOL_STATE_WRONG_ID;
464 
465  if (_toolState && _toolState->isValid() && req.id == _toolState->getId())
466  {
467  _toolCommand(req.position, req.max_torque, req.speed);
468 
469  _waitForToolStop(req.id, _gripper_timeout);
470 
471  // set hold torque
472  _toolCommand(_toolState->getPosition(), req.hold_torque, req.speed);
473 
474  _toolState->setState(ToolState::GRIPPER_STATE_OK);
475 
476  ROS_DEBUG("ToolsInterfaceCore::_callbackControlGripper : OK !");
477  res.state = _toolState->getState();
478  }
479 
480  return true;
481 }

489 bool ToolsInterfaceCore::_callbackPullAirVacuumPump(tools_interface::ToolCommand::Request &req,
490  tools_interface::ToolCommand::Response &res)
491 {
492  lock_guard<mutex> lck(_tool_mutex);
493  res.state = ToolState::TOOL_STATE_WRONG_ID;
494 
495  // check gripper id, in case no ping has been done before, or wrong id given
496  if (_toolState)
497  {
498  if (_toolState->isValid() && req.id == _toolState->getId())
499  {
500  // to be put in tool state
501  auto pull_air_velocity = static_cast<uint32_t>(req.speed);
502  auto pull_air_position = static_cast<uint32_t>(req.position);
503  int pull_air_hold_torque = req.hold_torque;
504  int pull_air_max_torque = req.max_torque;
505  // set vacuum pump pos, vel and torque
506  if (_ttl_interface)
507  {
508  _toolCommand(pull_air_position, pull_air_max_torque, pull_air_velocity);
509 
510  _waitForToolStop(req.id, _vacuum_pump_timeout);
511 
512  // set hold torque
513  _toolCommand(_toolState->getPosition(), pull_air_hold_torque, pull_air_velocity);
514 
515  _toolState->setState(ToolState::VACUUM_PUMP_STATE_PULLED);
516  }
517  }
518  res.state = _toolState->getState();
519  }
520 
521  return true;
522 }

569 void ToolsInterfaceCore::_waitForToolStop(int id, int timeout)
570 {
571  // Wait for moving status to acknowledge that the motion has stopped or return if timeout
572  std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
573  int moving_counter{ 10 };
574 
575  while (std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::seconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start_time).count() <
576  timeout)
577  {
578  uint8_t moving_status;
579  _ttl_interface->readMoving(id, moving_status);
580 
581  // Count the number of times the tool has been detected as not moving consecutively
582  if (moving_status == 0)
583  {
584  moving_counter--;
585  }
586  else
587  {
588  moving_counter = 10;
589  }
590 
591  // If the tool has been detected as not moving 10 times in a row, we consider that the vacuum pump cannot move
592  // anymore
593  if (moving_counter <= 0)
594  {
595  break;
596  }
597 
598  std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
599  }
600 }

609 void ToolsInterfaceCore::_toolCommand(uint32_t position, int torque, uint32_t velocity)
610 {
611  uint8_t tool_id = _toolState->getId();
612  EHardwareType tool_motor_type = _toolState->getHardwareType();
613 
614  if (EHardwareType::XL320 == tool_motor_type)
615  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(
616  EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_VELOCITY, tool_id, std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ velocity }));
617 
618  // need to set max torque. It makes cmd changing speed take effect
619  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(
620  EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_EFFORT, tool_id, std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ static_cast<uint16_t>(torque) }));
621 
622  _ttl_interface->addSingleCommandToQueue(std::make_unique<DxlSingleCmd>(EDxlCommandType::CMD_TYPE_POSITION, tool_id,
623  std::initializer_list<uint32_t>{ position }));
624 }

629 void ToolsInterfaceCore::_publishToolConnection(const ros::TimerEvent &)
630 {
631  lock_guard<mutex> lck(_tool_mutex);
632 
633  ROS_DEBUG("ToolsInterfaceCore::_publishToolConnection : publishing");
634 
635  tools_interface::Tool msg;
636 
637  if (_toolState)
638  {
639  // check that current managed tool is still connected
640  if (_toolState->isValid())
641  {
642  if (_ttl_interface && !_ttl_interface->scanMotorId(_toolState->getId()))
643  {
644  // try 3 times to ping tool, ttl failed to ping tool sometimes
645  if (3 == _tool_ping_failed_cnt)
646  {
647  ROS_INFO("Tools Interface - Unset Current Tools");
648  _ttl_interface->unsetTool(_toolState->getId());
649 
650  // reset state
651  _toolState->reset();
652  _tool_ping_failed_cnt = 0;
653  }
654  else
655  _tool_ping_failed_cnt++;
656  }
657  else
658  {
659  _tool_ping_failed_cnt = 0;
660  }
661  }
662 
663  // publish message
664 
665  int id = _toolState->getId();
666  EHardwareType motor_type = _toolState->getHardwareType();
667 
668  msg.id = static_cast<int8_t>(id);
669  msg.position = _toolState->getPosition();
670  msg.state = _toolState->getState();
671 
672  switch (motor_type)
673  {
674  case EHardwareType::STEPPER:
675  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::STEPPER;
676  break;
677  case EHardwareType::XL430:
678  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::XL430;
679  break;
680  case EHardwareType::XC430:
681  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::XC430;
682  break;
683  case EHardwareType::XM430:
684  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::XM430;
685  break;
686  case EHardwareType::XL320:
687  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::XL320;
688  break;
689  case EHardwareType::XL330:
690  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::XL330;
691  break;
692  case EHardwareType::FAKE_DXL_MOTOR:
693  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::FAKE_DXL_MOTOR;
694  break;
695  case EHardwareType::FAKE_STEPPER_MOTOR:
696  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::STEPPER;
697  break;
698  default:
699  msg.motor_type = tools_interface::Tool::NO_MOTOR;
700  break;
701  }
702  }
703 
704  _tool_connection_publisher.publish(msg);
